original_target.title: Nonbranching of analytic equiregular sub-Riemannian geodesics
original_target.outcome: Claim: negative: branching analytic equiregular minimizers

scope_comparison: Theorem1.3 claims branching minimizing geodesics in Carnot groups. Those structures are analytic and equiregular, and the lift preserves length minimality and branching of curves sharing a nontrivial initial segment. Common arclength parametrization gives the local unit-speed convention. The nonequiregular3D example alone would not suffice; the Carnot lift is essential.
